Character Story: This is Fobural, a resident of a distant red galaxy. There are no planets in our understanding here. It is a space without time and borders, there are no objects, things, plants, anything that is familiar to us. Foburals live in the energy space, they are born from the energy, they feed on it and then dissolve, turning into the energy space. Bliss is the only emotion they know. They can feel it by giving their energy to something or someone. However, they cannot transmit it to each other, therefore they are anxious for connections with other worlds with which they can contact to change their energy to feeling.
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: This is Shemur, a tiny inhabitant of all the space that exists, and which does not exist. They live among us, on Earth, on the Sun, in our entire universe, and beyond. However, not everyone can see them, for this you need to detach yourself from the familiar world, have a good heart, pure thoughts, a desire to create. Shemur opens to those in whom it sees it all, they are very clever, since they have always existed, they know the answers to all questions, even those that will not be asked soon. Shemur will help as long as the soul of the being (human) has good intentions.  They see us only as a thought. They do not distinguish between shape, color, gender, or age. Just thoughts.
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: Here the atmosphere is a liquid, and the whole world is "marine". The world is a garden. It is inhabited by Aronils, who cultivate this garden of life. They plant the sacred golden thread to grow new "plants" that will allow us to hear each other better. 'To hear' here means to understand each other, and not just a physical characteristic. They communicate by touching others with their spherules. One Aronil can speak to thousands of different creatures at once. Each spherule is a channel of communication, the older the Aronil is, the more conversations it can support.
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: This is Skyenti planet inhabited by Skyenats. Here white spheres fly in space, containing inside everything that has happened, like our history books, however, you can't rewrite, change or erase anything, the information is securely stored. The world of the Skyenats has no top or bottom. They live inside the planet, it is a hollow sphere, in its space "float" all the inhabitants. They, like us, can love and hate, can build and destroy, but, thanks to these spheres, have great wisdom and rarely repeat the mistakes of the past. They perfectly analyze the information available to each inhabitant, so each "mistake" is the result of a completely new experience. They try to leave positive experiences in everyday life. Wise and very happy Skyenats.
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: Sonoria planet. These are thousands of small planets that are very close to each other. Each planet is inhabited by one Sonor only. All planets are not alike, like snowflakes in our world, they have their differences, but brighter. Each planet is a fantasy of its inhabitant. It creates it as it wants, fills it with plants, forms the space, decides whether there will be water or not and in which direction it should flow, even upwards; they control everything that surrounds them, changing following their mood. All this they can do thanks to a small golden spherule, thanks to it they also communicate with each other. Sonorans are very fond of music and arrange incredible concerts in their universe, if we are lucky enough to get there one day, we will see a beautiful dance of a thousand planets.
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: Olamishes have the ability to delicate work with space and exist near the water, it is vital to them. They are born from large eggs, which initially float through the air in the form of large clouds. Their mood can be read from three gray "pouches" on their faces, which change color. Olamishes are kind and can create anything from "air".
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: Dreamas live very far from our universe; they are incredibly large. The planet Earth is like a tennis ball to them. There aren't many of them at all, maybe a couple hundred. They have appeared only recently, created by a dreamer from Sonoria (although he does not know about it). Dreamas are beautiful and powerful. They can collect thousands of small planets in space and create habitable ones by combining different materials, substances, creating an atmosphere or energy space. They are like children sculpting from plasticine.
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: This big-eyed Zhuzhak is a warrener. Yellow tube-eyed docs are the inhabitants of its planet, they are very sensitive and need care. Zhuzhak takes care of the living organisms of these regions, heals, if necessary, collects information with the help of many eyes, and transmits information to the bagel in the "sky" by a golden thread that comes out of its fin. The scientists of this planet live there.
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: Indezes live on a gas planet, they fly in space, which is filled with blue gas. They can only live within its limits, they need it as much as we need air. Indezes are not very sociable, they live on the other side of our universe. We are perfectly visible to them as if the black space is a glass through which we do not see anyone. On the contrary, they can see everything perfectly well from the back side. One day we will hear a knock, it will be Indezes lightly knocking on our "black glass", wanting to get to know us better. They're good, we'll make friends.
Label: Unlabeled

Character Story: Meeting them can be the most beautiful event in the life of any creature. It is they who open the way to all the worlds. No one knows where Tutomirons live. Most likely, they do not have their own planet. They are nomads in the universes, in different worlds, times, parallels, and everything that can only be and is still inaccessible to our consciousness. They are guides with the purest soul and open heart; through them you can get anywhere. They also say that this ability is available to everyone, it is only necessary to turn towards yourself and smile with your heart.
Label: Unlabeled
